description: NaLa₆Ga₃S₁₄ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share faces with two equivalent GaS₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.69 Å) and three longer (2.75 Å) Na-S bond lengths. There are two inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of La-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.32 Å. In the second La site, La is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven S atoms. There are a spread of La-S bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.06 Å. There are three inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and three longer (2.30 Å) Ga-S bond lengths. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and three longer (2.30 Å) Ga-S bond lengths. In the third Ga site, Ga is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted GaS₆ octahedra that share faces with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.62 Å) Ga-S bond lengths. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three La and one Ga atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three La and one Ga atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three La, and one Ga atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Na, four La, and one Ga atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to three equivalent La and one Ga atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to three equivalent La and one Ga atom.
